quizzes.question: The Polish Glacier on this mountain was named following a 1934 expedition led by Konstanty Jodko-Narkiewicz. quizzes.explanation: Mount Aconcagua is located in Argentina and is the highest peak in both the Western and Southern Hemispheres.

quizzes.question: This city's name derives from a Mohawk word chronicled by Samuel de Champlain, and its suburbs include Mississauga and York. quizzes.explanation: Toronto is the capital of Ontario and the largest city in Canada.

quizzes.question: The northernmost section of this mountain range is known as the Rif, and its rain shadow helped form the Sahara Desert. quizzes.explanation: The Atlas Mountains span northwest Africa and separate the Mediterranean and Atlantic coastlines from the Sahara Desert.

quizzes.question: An aluminum processing city whose name means 'Magnetic Mountain,' Magnitogorsk, is located in this mountain range. quizzes.explanation: The Ural Mountains run north-to-south through western Russia and form a traditional geographical boundary between Europe and Asia.

quizzes.question: The first cable car in the Americas ascended this mountain, passing through Morro da Urca en route to its peak. quizzes.explanation: Sugarloaf Mountain (Pão de Açúcar) is a peak situated in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, at the mouth of Guanabara Bay.

quizzes.question: The oldest operating example of these facilities is Bakken in Copenhagen, which opened in 1583. quizzes.explanation: Theme parks (or amusement parks) originated in Europe as pleasure gardens and expanded worldwide into modern entertainment complexes.

quizzes.question: This state controls the eastern slope of Pico de Orizaba and contains the Olmec archaeological site of Tres Zapotes. quizzes.question: The Polisario Front seeks the independence of this region, whose de facto capital and largest city is Laâyoune. quizzes.explanation: Western Sahara is a sparsely populated territory in the Maghreb region of North Africa, disputed between Morocco and the Sahrawi Republic.

quizzes.question: Before creating this landmark, its sculptor Gutzon Borglum worked on the Stone Mountain Confederate memorial in Georgia. quizzes.question: This region's Ap Lei Chau is one of the most densely populated islands in the world. quizzes.question: An aluminum processing city whose name means 'Magnetic Mountain,' Magnitogorsk, is located in this mountain range. quizzes.question: This city contains a public park designed by Yo-Yo Ma based on a Bach cello suite, and its Chinatown is centered along Dundas Street. quizzes.explanation: Toronto is the largest city in Canada, home to the CN Tower, Mississauga suburbs, and the Music Garden.

quizzes.question: This mountain shares its name with the tallest ski resort in Maine and overlooks Botafogo Bay. quizzes.question: The Polish Glacier on this mountain was named following a 1934 expedition led by Konstanty Narkiewicz. quizzes.question: The northernmost extension of this mountain range is known as the Rif near the Strait of Gibraltar. quizzes.question: Buildings in this city are restricted from exceeding the height of its central hill situated between the Laurentian and Appalachian ranges. quizzes.explanation: Montréal is the largest city in Quebec, situated on an island at the confluence of the St. Lawrence and Ottawa rivers.

quizzes.question: A massive 140-foot statue of Lord Murugan guards the entrance to the Batu Caves within this Malaysian state. quizzes.explanation: Selangor surrounds Kuala Lumpur and contains the Batu Caves and the royal capital of Klang.

quizzes.question: Before sculpting this landmark, its primary artist created the colossal relief of Confederate leaders at Stone Mountain. quizzes.question: A Swiss expedition led by Edouard Wyss-Dunant pioneered the South Col route on this peak in 1952. quizzes.explanation: Mount Everest is the highest mountain on Earth, first officially summited by Hillary and Norgay in 1953.

quizzes.question: This range includes the Dinaric branch to the southeast as well as peaks like the Eiger and Jungfrau. quizzes.explanation: The Alps are the highest and most extensive mountain range system that lies entirely in Europe.

quizzes.question: This mountain range's highest peak is Mount Toubkal, which lies within a namesake national park in Morocco. quizzes.question: This region contains the island of Ap Lei Chau, one of the most densely populated islands in the world. quizzes.explanation: Ap Lei Chau and Victoria Harbour are key geographical features of Hong Kong.

quizzes.question: The royal capital of this Malaysian state is Klang, and it completely surrounds the federal territories of Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya. quizzes.explanation: Selangor is Malaysia's most populous state and encompasses the Batu Caves and Klang.

quizzes.question: This city's Miracle Garden is the world's largest natural flower garden, featuring over 50 million flowers. quizzes.explanation: Dubai is home to landmarks such as the Miracle Garden, Palm Jumeirah, and the Burj Khalifa.

quizzes.question: The industrial city of Magnitogorsk was built near the southern end of this mountain range to extract iron ore. quizzes.question: This peak looks over Botafogo Bay and can be reached via a two-stage cable car that passes over Morro da Urca. quizzes.explanation: Sugarloaf Mountain (Pão de Açúcar) is a famous peak situated at the mouth of Guanabara Bay in Rio de Janeiro.

quizzes.question: This city is home to Mount Royal, a hill that restricts the height of its downtown skyscrapers. Located at the confluence of the Ottawa and St. Lawrence Rivers, it is the largest city in its province. For the point, name this second-most populous city in Canada, located in Quebec.
quizzes.explanation: Montreal is the largest city in Quebec and is built around Mount Royal at the confluence of the St. Lawrence and Ottawa rivers.

quizzes.question: Gravity trains have been proposed to travel between antipodes, which represent these locations on opposite sides of the globe. For the point, name these points on Earth that are diametrically opposite to one another.
quizzes.explanation: Antipodes are pairs of points on the Earth's surface that are diametrically opposite to each other.
